source.label: WHO documents, as listed in the Alert tab's data pack
notes: Published definitions are quoted or closely paraphrased from the cited WHO documents. Presets are this project's notification defaults, not clinical or policy rules; label them as presets in the UI.
Copied verbatim from k540e-data-pack/k540e-thresholds.json (history) at commit a1cc503.

items.text: A WHO evidence review group suggested considering stopping SP in pregnancy where K540E exceeded 95% and A581G exceeded 10%. Superseded by current guidance.
WHO removed the restriction on infant chemoprevention with SP based on prevalence of Pfdhps 540 mutations.
